items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Frank Sinatra is mentioned by the interviewer in relation to Andre Prentice; the interviewee (Red Callender) does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Frank Sinatra.

ctx.x: Well, at that time Andre I would say had the qualities of a good musician, but he was a little immature. You know, at 17 you... He could play, he had the facility, but he really wasn't into Jazz. He played what he had heard other people play at that time. He hadn't developed his own style.
I heard him play Classical Music at that point. He was a guest on the Frank Sinatra radio show when he was 17. That's when I first heard. He was there because Frank knew his father at MGM.
His father was a conductor at MGM, wasn't he.
